newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL HOUSING BANK SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 36.6PCT.
newsitem.headline: NATL HOUSING BANK SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 36.6PCT.

text.p: National Housing Bank of Greece, a National Bank subsidiary specialising in mortgages, said in a statement its half-year pretax profit rose 36.6 percent to 2.24 billion drachmas.
Loans stood at 93.2 billion drachmas at end-June 1997, up 14.2 percent on 81.6 billion a year earlier.
Over the same period, deposits grew 26.4 percent to exceed 120 billion drachmas from 94.9 billion.
Total assets were up 22.6 percent to 137.5 billion drachmas at the end of the first half. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
